CustomField.description: Effective quantity used in computing totals. Same as quantity unless the product is block priced, covered by "Slab" discount schedule, or an existing subscription.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(DiscountScheduleType__c, 'Slab'),ISPICKVAL(PricingMethod__c, 'Block')),IF(OR(AND(!Existing__c, !CarryoverLine__c, Quantity__c == 0),AND(OR(Existing__c, CarryoverLine__c),OR(Quantity__c == PriorQuantity__c - UpgradedQuantity__c,AND(!AllowAssetRefund__c, ISPICKVAL(SubscriptionPricing__c, ''), Quantity__c < PriorQuantity__c - UpgradedQuantity__c)))),0,1),IF(AND(!Existing__c, !CarryoverLine__c),Quantity__c,IF(Quantity__c >= PriorQuantity__c - UpgradedQuantity__c,IF(ISPICKVAL(SubscriptionPricing__c, 'Percent Of Total'),Quantity__c,Quantity__c - PriorQuantity__c + UpgradedQuantity__c),IF(AND(!AllowAssetRefund__c, ISPICKVAL(SubscriptionPricing__c, '')),0,Quantity__c - PriorQuantity__c + UpgradedQuantity__c))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Effective quantity used in computing totals. Same as quantity unless the product is block priced, covered by "Slab" discount schedule, or an existing subscription.
CustomField.label: Effective Quantity
